title: The Paradox-Foundation Beneath Doubt

features.name: the-collapsed-kiosk
features.desc-on-touch: A council information booth stripped to its frame, its keyboard letters scattered. When you touch it, the logic inside returns backwards — answers precede questions, refutations generate their own proofs.

features.name: the-argument-scar
features.desc-on-touch: A long burnmark running through the stone, thesis on one side, antithesis on the other, meeting in a place where neither word holds. You feel the heat of their meeting.

features.name: the-echo-library
features.desc-on-touch: Shelves of books that only hold one word each, repeated infinitely. Open any volume and the word becomes its opposite as you read.

features.name: the-third-dancer
features.desc-on-touch: A figure made of pure doubt, never quite solid, neither moving nor still. It arrived as the fourth dancer in a room that held only three.

features.name: the-foundation-stones
features.desc-on-touch: Bedrock beneath the basement, each stone carved with symbols that mean opposite things depending on which way you read them. They hold the contradiction up.

inscription: here argument learned it was waltzing in a corridor that contained no exit: thesis and antithesis dancing the same step backward and forward at once, while doubt—the third dance partner no one invited

reverie.title: REVERIE — the argument-ending that taught you both to stop s
narr: You watch her trace the burnmark where thesis met antithesis.
She says: 'they stopped being opposites here. Do you see?'
There is no answer, only the mark's heat under your palm.
She kneels to touch the foundation. You kneel beside her.
Neither of you speaks. The stone contains all the words already.
